verdict.rationale: Yapily documents an official MCP server that Claude, Cursor or other AI coding agents can connect to, and a probe confirms the docs page exists. But the server only gives a live, searchable connection to the documentation, not agent access to the payments or data APIs. missing for 10: an MCP server exposing Yapily API operations (accounts, transactions, payments), setup/auth details for the MCP endpoint, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect Claude, Cursor, or another AI coding agent directly to these docs via MCP, llms.txt, or Agent Skills.
Connecting over MCP gives your agent a live, searchable connection to this documentation.
